card.title: Don’t Question the Premise
card.instruction: Redirect every attempt to ask why the strange situation exists toward what must happen next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hold this bucket under the seascape. I'll get towels before the gallery floor floods.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why is a painting leaking? I said we should buy a print.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can choose the replacement. Tilt the bucket toward the waves.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why are there fish? This bucket's nearly full.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fetch the aquarium from reception. I'll hold this one until you're back.

mechanism: A answers questions about a leaking seascape with concrete containment jobs rather than an explanation of its existence.
confusable: Unlike curious rule testing, A must redirect origin questions toward managing the next consequence.
comparison: Fish change the required container to an aquarium, unlike the ghost scene adapting breakfast to a departing driver.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
